symbols.signature: tally(counts: Tally, node: ast.Node, depth: int) mutates(counts)
symbols.snippet:
tally(counts: Tally, node: ast.Node, depth: int) mutates(counts):
    counts.nodes = counts.nodes + 1
    if depth > counts.depth:
        counts.depth = depth
    match node:
        case ast.Node.atom(_, _):
            counts.atoms = counts.atoms + 1
        case ast.Node.string(_, _):
            counts.strings = counts.strings + 1
        case ast.Node.integer(value, _):
            counts.ints = counts.ints + 1
            counts.values = counts.values + float(value)
        case ast.Node.decimal(value, _, _):
            counts.floats = counts.floats + 1
            counts.values = counts.values + value
        case ast.Node.measure(value, _):
            counts.measures = counts.measures + 1
            counts.values = counts.values + value
        case ast.Node.form(entries, _):
            counts.forms = counts.forms + 1
            for child in entries:
                tally(counts, child, depth + 1)

main(args: list[str], fs: Filesystem, out: Stream, err: Stream) -> int:
    if len(args) == 0:
        err.print("usage: main <file.sexp> [--render]")
        return 2
    path = args[0]
    render_only = len(args) > 1 and args[1] == "--render"
    source = b""
    match read_file(fs, path):
        case Ok(data):
            source = data
        case Err(problem):
            err.print("read failed:", problem)
            return 2
    match parser.parse(source):
        case Ok(nodes):
            if render_only:
                out.print(printer.render(nodes))
            else:
                out.print(summarise(nodes))
            return 0
        case Err(problem):
            err.print(f"parse error: {problem.message} at {problem.line}:{problem.col}")
            return 1

symbols.snippet:
span_at(src: bytes, offset: int, options: ParseOptions) -> ast.Span:
    line = 1
    col = 1
    index = 0
    size = len(src)
    stop = offset
    if stop > size:
        stop = size
    newline = tk.char_byte(options.dialect.syntax.newline)
    while index < stop:
        if src[index] == newline:
            line = line + 1
            col = 1
        else:
            col = col + 1
        index = index + 1
    return ast.Span(line=line, col=col, offset=offset)

parse_unit(src: bytes, token: tk.Token, next_pos: int, options: ParseOptions) -> Result[Step, ParseError]:
    text = token.text
    number_text = text
    factor = 1.0
    matched = False
    for rule in options.dialect.numbers.dimensions:
        if text.endswith(rule.suffix):
            number_text = text[0:len(text) - len(rule.suffix)]
            factor = rule.to_mm
            matched = True
            break
    if not matched:
        factor = source_dimension_factor(src, token, options)
    match float(number_text):
        case Some(value):
            return Ok(Step(node=ast.Node.measure(value * factor, token.span), next=next_pos))
        case None:
            return Err(invalid_number(token))

symbols.snippet:
parse_with(src: bytes, options: ParseOptions) -> Result[list[ast.Node], ParseError]:
    tokens: list[tk.Token] = []
    match tk.tokenize_with(src, options.dialect):
        case Ok(lexed):
            tokens = lexed
        case Err(problem):
            return Err(lex_failure(src, problem, options))
    nodes: list[ast.Node] = []
    pos = 0
    while True:
        token = tokens[pos]
        if token.kind == tk.Kind.eof:
            break
        parsed = parse_node(Cursor(src=src, tokens=tokens, pos=pos, options=options), 0)?
        nodes.append(parsed.node)
        pos = parsed.next
    return Ok(nodes)

si_suffix_len(lx: Lexer, numbers: NumberPolicy) -> int:
    c0 = char_at(lx, 0)
    match find_scale(numbers, c0):
        case Some(rule):
            c1 = char_at(lx, 1)
            if rule.requires_unit:
                if has_unit_letter(numbers, c1) and not atom_continue_byte(lx, peek_at(lx, 2)):
                    return 2
                return 0
            if not atom_continue_byte(lx, peek_at(lx, 1)):
                return 1
            if has_unit_letter(numbers, c1) and not atom_continue_byte(lx, peek_at(lx, 2)):
                return 2
            return 0
        case None:

            return 0

symbols.snippet:
read_atom(lx: Lexer, line: int, col: int, offset: int) -> Token:
    start = lx.pos
    # The atom-start predicate accepted this byte, so consume it even when a
    # dialect's continuation class does not include it; the scan then stops at
    # the first byte that is not an atom character.
    advance(lx)
    while atom_continue_byte(lx, peek(lx)):
        advance(lx)
    return Token(kind=Kind.atom, text=lexeme(lx.src, start, lx.pos), span=ast.Span(line=line, col=col, offset=offset))

symbols.name: exponent_len
symbols.snippet:
exponent_len(lx: Lexer) -> int:
    letter = peek(lx)
    if letter != 101 and letter != 69:  # 'e' / 'E'
        return 0
    step = 1
    sign = peek_at(lx, step)
    if sign == 43 or sign == 45:  # '+' / '-'
        step = step + 1
    if not digit_byte(lx, peek_at(lx, step)):
        return 0
    while digit_byte(lx, peek_at(lx, step)):
        step = step + 1
    if atom_continue_byte(lx, peek_at(lx, step)):
        return 0
    return step

default_fits_inline(entries: list[ast.Node], layout: Layout) -> bool effects(managed_allocation):
    total = 2
    gap = len(layout.inline_separator)
    index = 0
    while index < len(entries):
        if index > 0:
            total = total + gap
        match estimate_width(entries[index], 0, layout):
            case Some(width):
                total = total + width
            case None:
                return False
        if total > layout.max_width:
            return False
        index = index + 1
    return True

symbols.signature: push_node(parts: list[str], node: ast.Node, indent: int, style: Style) mutates(parts)
symbols.snippet:
push_node(parts: list[str], node: ast.Node, indent: int, style: Style) mutates(parts):
    match node:
        case ast.Node.form(entries, _):
            if len(entries) == 0:
                parts.append(style.layout.empty_form)
                return
            fits = style.fits_inline
            if fits(entries, style.layout):
                # Short enough (and shallow enough) for one line.
                parts.append("(")
                index = 0
                while index < len(entries):
                    if index > 0:
                        parts.append(style.layout.inline_separator)
                    push_node(parts, entries[index], indent + style.layout.indent_step, style)
                    index = index + 1
                parts.append(")")
                return
            # Too wide or too deep: by default the first child stays on the "("
            # line and every later child starts an indented line of its own.
            parts.append("(")
            step = style.layout.indent_step
            index = 0
            if style.layout.first_on_open:
                push_node(parts, entries[0], indent + step, style)
                index = 1
            while index < len(entries):
                parts.append(style.layout.line_ending)
                parts.append(indent_text_of(style, indent + step))
                push_node(parts, entries[index], indent + step, style)
                index = index + 1
            parts.append(")")
            return
        case ast.Node.atom(text, _):
            spell_atom = style.atom_text
            parts.append(spell_atom(text))
            return
        case ast.Node.string(content, _):
            escape_text = style.string_text
            parts.append(style.layout.string_quote)
            parts.append(escape_text(content))
            parts.append(style.layout.string_quote)
            return
        case ast.Node.integer(value, _):
            parts.append(str(value))
            return
        case ast.Node.decimal(value, _, literal):
            # A suffixed literal prints as it was written; re-deriving the text
            # from the f64 would rewrite `100nF` as `0.0000001`.
            match literal:
                case Some(text):
                    parts.append(text)
                case None:
                    spell_number = style.number_text
                    parts.append(spell_number(value))
            return
        case ast.Node.measure(value, _):
            spell_number = style.number_text
            parts.append(spell_number(value))
            parts.append(style.layout.measure_suffix)
            return
